# Lightsage

Lightsage is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Lightsage is an Agent-Led Growth Platform for software companies that helps AI agents discover, recommend, and use their products. Lightsage employs 3 people. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Singapore.

## About

Infrastructure for the Agent Economy and Agent-Led Growth. Track, benchmark, and improve how coding agents discover and use your API, CLI and MCP. Powering enterprises and unicorn startups to be the default tool agent recommends. Learn more about agent experience: https://lightsage.com.

# Lightsprint (YC P26)

Lightsprint (YC P26) is a Software Development company. LightSprint is a company that helps PMs, designers, and engineers plan, build, and ship in one shared session on their existing codebase. They offer services like Google Docs for coding agents. Lightsprint (YC P26) employs 4 people. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States, with an office in Dover.
